description:
We are a team passionate about space, technology, and history. AstroNex is our educational website exploring NASA missions, spacecraft, rovers, satellites, and their discoveries.

Muhammadsaid — Research & documentation.
Sharifkhucha — Coding & 3D models.
Azimkhon — Animation & design.
Zafar & Fazliddin — Mini-game development.

We combine creativity, research, and technology to make space exploration engaging for everyone.
